steps: Scrape out cracked or missing caulk with a utility knife or caulk removal tool.
Clean the gap and let it dry completely.
Apply exterior-grade, paintable caulk in a continuous bead at a 45-degree angle.
Smooth the bead with a wet finger or caulk tool.
Let cure per label instructions before painting over it.

materials.name: DAP Alex Flex 10 oz. paintable exterior caulk
ALLWAY CT31 3-in-1 caulk remover and finishing tool
ScotchBlue 2090 1.88 in. x 60 yd painter's tape
